introHtml: American Giant jackets are built in the United States from heavyweight fleece and ring-spun cotton, offering durability that stands up to daily wear. Whether you need embroidered full-zip hoodies for a corporate uniform or screen-printed crew sweatshirts for a promotional giveaway, these pieces hold their shape and color wash after wash. The classic fit and clean finish make them a favorite among marketing directors and safety managers who want a premium look without sacrificing comfort.
